chapters.title: Where it started
lines: It started in 2015, with birthday videos made as gifts for friends.
Then came our batch tours, and a tribute to a teacher.

chapters.title: Hits and hills
lines: “Criticism is highly appreciated.” That is how I shared my first Keokradong film.
A 41-second campus cover from that year was watched 37K times.
And a tribute to Chester Bennington of Linkin Park.

chapters.title: Stories, trips and life
lines: “A story of three days. A story of seven people. A story of moments when we were infinite.”

chapters.title: Latest films
lines: “I made a film, after so long.”
“Not everyone gets to wear the jersey. But some of us are meant to tell the story.”
“Maybe the perfect time never really comes. So I’m choosing now.” That is how Bohrscope began in 2025.

films.title: Somewhere Only We Know
films.logline: I made a film, after so long.

films.title: Bangladeshi Football in Finland
films.subtitle: Tournament teaser
films.logline: A small teaser for the biggest Bangladeshi football tournament in Finland.
films.notes: A way to capture what it feels like when a community comes alive through a game we all grew up with. From one pass to another, from one city to another, this is how we stay connected.

films.title: Where the Lines Divide
films.logline: দুটো মানচিত্র এঁকে দুটো দেশের মাঝে...

films.title: Beyond Return
films.subtitle: Faslon Ko Takalluf
films.logline: The horizon gathers certain souls the way the sea gathers rivers, with a silence that never lets them return.

films.title: Can't Wait to Be King
films.logline: Today, he is just a puppy. Tomorrow, he will be ready.

films.title: Can't Play? Then Shoot.
films.logline: Can't play football? At least I can shoot it.
films.notes: That is what I told myself, and then I picked up the camera. Not everyone gets to wear the jersey, but some of us are meant to tell the story. This team in Tampere let me into their practice ground and into their world, and I tried to return the favour by turning their fight into film. Even if I am not on the pitch, this is my game.

films.title: Echoes of High Hopes
films.logline: There was a time we thought we would never lose each other.
films.notes: There was a time we thought we would never lose each other. That the sky would always be blue, and home would always be just a walk away. But time has a strange way of making us drift, like birds carried by winds we never meant to follow.

films.title: দেশান্তরী
films.subtitle: The One Who Left
films.logline: New cities, new skies, and a part of me that stays behind.
films.notes: I have been to many places lately, crossing seas, stopping at different ports, watching sunsets I had never seen before. But no matter how far I go, something inside me stays behind. This was the first film on Bohrscope, a channel named after the bioscope, the old storytelling machine, and Bohr, my creative alter ego.

films.title: A Day in the Life of Wang Yu Sha
films.subtitle: Asian Futurism
films.logline: A city of neon lights, a world driven by AI, and one life caught between tradition and technology.

films.title: Where the Past and Future Meet
films.subtitle: Asian Futurism
films.logline: How old Asian traditions could meet a future run on technology, told in place of a slide deck.
films.notes: A course project where the only rule was to present in a unique way, so our team made a film instead of a presentation. It mixes clips from Blade Runner 2049, Ghost in the Shell (2017), Love, Death & Robots: The Witness, Altered Carbon and Cyberpunk 2077 with AI-generated visuals.

films.title: LIFE
films.subtitle: A digital story
films.logline: Nature, animals and the sea, as a way to look at emotional balance and the human need for connection.
films.notes: Through scenes of nature, animals and the sea, I explore the balance of emotions and the human need for connection, peace and purpose. The film reflects psychological ideas I studied in Human-Technology Interaction.

films.title: Escaping the Ordinary
films.logline: Eight hearts fuelled by dreams, eight souls chasing the wind.
films.notes: Eight hearts fuelled by dreams, eight souls chasing the wind. In the embrace of the unknown, they found their truest selves.

films.title: Life's A Beach
films.subtitle: SWE'18 batch tour
films.logline: Bus rides full of laughter, new places, and one last sunset together.
films.notes: As the sun rose on the first day of our SWE'18 batch tour, we set out on a journey that took us to stunning places and gave us memories for a lifetime. We explored, we learned, we grew, and we bonded as a batch.

films.title: Memories That Last
films.subtitle: SWE'18 batch tour teaser
films.logline: The teaser for Life's A Beach, released five days before the full film.

films.title: One Island, Four Days, Sixteen People
films.logline: Sandy shores, meals over open flames, and a promise to return.
films.notes: They walked on sandy shores, cooked meals over open flames and swam in clear water. As the boat took them back to reality, they promised each other they would return to the island someday.

films.title: Esho Amar Shohore x IUT
films.logline: It is that শহরবন্দী মেঘ time of the year.

films.title: Rangamati Story
films.logline: A story of three days. A story of seven people. A story of moments when we were infinite.
films.notes: I took a trip to Rangamati with some amazing people and had some of the best days of my life. We shared stories, trips and life. Through the ups and downs, we made memories I will never forget. Headphones recommended.

films.title: Run From Rust
films.logline: Workload, family, existential crisis. We all wanted to go as far as one can go.
films.notes: All of us wanted to go as high as green goes, as deep as the ocean runs, as far as one can go. Solo? Better. A team? Could share. We shared. Stories, trips and life.

films.title: A Tour of IUT
films.logline: Trying to get distracted for a while, hoping we get back to normal life soon.

films.title: Keokradong Diary
films.logline: Ten friends, one destination, a journey to find Neverland.
films.notes: I had no intention of making a cinematic video. I just tried to relive some good memories by turning back the pages of my Keokradong diary. For a few days they were disconnected from their world, the mountains embraced them, and clouds showed them the staircases to paradise.

films.title: Thank You Chester
films.logline: A tribute to Chester Bennington of Linkin Park.
films.notes: Thank you Chester, for all the weapons to battle in those endless nights of depression.

films.title: Let's Slowly Disappear in the Heaven
Break The Circle, Season IX
films.subtitle: The Exhibition
films.logline: A throwback to Break The Circle, Season IX: The Exhibition, made for IUTPS.

films.title: Keokradong
films.subtitle: Into the Nature
films.logline: A trek to Keokradong, a 986 metre peak in Bandarban, and the landscapes on the way up.
films.notes: Keokradong is a peak in Bandarban, Bangladesh, at 986 metres (3,235 ft). This is what we captured on the way. It is safe to say I fell in love with Keokradong.

films.subtitle: Batch tour teaser
films.logline: Let 7 November come.

films.title: CSE'18 Batch Tour
films.logline: The good people of CSE'18 and the time of their lives.

films.title: A Tribute to Jaharlal Sarkar Sir
films.logline: One name. A teacher who witnessed forty years of education.
films.notes: জহরলাল সরকার। একটি নাম। চল্লিশ বছরের শিক্ষা ব্যবস্থার সাক্ষী একজন মানুষ। তাঁর প্রতি শ্রদ্ধা জানানোর ক্ষুদ্র এক প্রচেষ্টা।
